verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail is a first-party assistant. It summarizes long threads, acts on multiple emails when asked, and reads Google Calendar availability to propose meeting times. The evidence never documents open-ended Q&A across the whole inbox and calendar, and one hands-on report says a Gmail AI summary hallucinated a delivery date, which undercuts grounding. Missing for 10: documented inbox-wide natural-language Q&A (who said what, what's outstanding), Q&A over calendar contents, citations or grounding guarantees on answers, independent corroboration of answer accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.
Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
